0022600208.text: The Houston Rockets (7-3) are second in the Southwest, one game back, and sixth in the West, and they come into this 11th game of the season on a two-game losing streak. The Denver Nuggets (5-3) are fourth in the Northwest, two games back, and ninth in the West, and they have won their last two. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and the Rockets lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 129-93 defeat in Denver on March 11, 2026.
